title: VerifyResult
description: What a verify Smith writes to /work/out/result.json. The engine checks it (ReadResultDelegate) before its own rules; the Smith checks it with check-result verify. Strict types where the engine branches, any non-empty JSON where it only passes content on.

outcome.description: Branched on by the engine and the BPMN.

content.description: Passed on to a brief or a GitHub comment, never branched on: any non-empty JSON. A string is shown as itself; an object or array as a fenced JSON block.
